userStories.notes: Migration applied locally via `bunx --bun wrangler d1 migrations apply ... --local` (the package.json `db:migrate:local` script runs wrangler directly which fails under Node 20 in this sandbox; use `bunx --bun wrangler` to invoke through Bun's runtime). userStories.notes: Resend SDK 6.x is dual-runtime (Node 20+ in package.json engines, but cleanly bundleable for Workers — wrangler picked it up without polyfills). `sendEmail({to,subject,html,text}, env)` lives in `src/server/email.ts`; templates in `src/server/email-templates.ts` return `{subject, html, text}` so the caller doesn't reach into module-private subject lines. userStories.title: Turnstile — validação server-side via siteverify
userStories.description: Como sistema, preciso validar o token do Cloudflare Turnstile antes de aceitar cadastros e logins.
acceptanceCriteria: Criar `src/server/turnstile.ts` exportando `verifyTurnstile(token: string, env: Env, remoteIp?: string): Promise<boolean>` que faz POST para `https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/siteverify` com `secret: env.TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY` e `response: token`
Retorna true se `success === true`, false caso contrário
Adicionar `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY` ao tipo `Env`
Criar hook Better Auth `before` para signUp e signIn que extrai `turnstileToken` do body e chama `verifyTurnstile` — falha com 400 se inválido
Quando `env.TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY` estiver vazio (dev), retorna true e loga aviso (não bloqueia dev)
Testes vitest com fetch mockado: token válido passa, inválido falha, erro de rede retorna false
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: `verifyTurnstile(token, env, remoteIp?)` lives in `src/server/turnstile.ts` and POSTs to `https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/siteverify` as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` (URLSearchParams). Returns `true` immediately when `env.TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY` is empty (dev bypass) with a console.warn; returns `false` for empty tokens, success=false, and any thrown fetch error (fail-closed). Wired into Better Auth via `hooks.before = createAuthMiddleware(...)` imported from `better-auth/api`. The hook matches `ctx.path === '/sign-up/email' | '/sign-in/email'`, reads `ctx.body.turnstileToken` (the BEFORE-hook ctx.body is the RAW parsed body from the router, not yet narrowed by the endpoint's zod schema — confirmed in `better-call/dist/router.mjs` + `to-auth-endpoints.mjs`, so unknown fields like `turnstileToken` survive even though sign-in's body schema would strip them later). On failure throws `new APIError('BAD_REQUEST', { message, code: 'TURNSTILE_INVALID' })` so Better Auth converts it to a 400 JSON response. Remote IP pulled from `cf-connecting-ip` first, falling back to `x-forwarded-for` first hop. Tests mock `globalThis.fetch` via `vi.spyOn` — initialize the spy in `beforeEach` to a module-scope `let` (otherwise `restoreAllMocks` orphans the reference, which silently caused the spy to disconnect during the first iteration of the test code). 6 vitest cases covering: success path + payload assertion, success=false, fetch throws, dev bypass (empty key), empty token early-return, remoteip propagated.

The factoring matters for tests: `<MemoryRouter><AppRoutes/></MemoryRouter>` drops in trivially, whereas wrapping the App component would nest two routers. Em sucesso: navega para `/check-email` (tela simples 'Verifique seu email')
Erros (email em uso, Turnstile inválido, senha fraca) exibidos inline em pt-BR
Link 'Já tem conta? Entrar' para `/login`
Adicionar `VITE_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY` ao .env.example
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Implemented in `src/features/auth/pages/register-page.tsx` with shadcn `<Form>` (FormProvider + FormField/FormItem/FormLabel/FormControl/FormMessage) + `useForm({ resolver: zodResolver(registerSchema), mode: 'onBlur' })`. The shadcn `form.tsx` component was added by hand (`bunx shadcn add form` failed offline) — same shape as upstream but uses our existing `Label` (no `@radix-ui/react-label` dep) and exports `Form, FormField, FormItem, FormLabel, FormControl, FormDescription, FormMessage, useFormField`. Turnstile widget lives in `src/features/auth/components/turnstile-field.tsx` wrapping `<Turnstile/>` from `@marsidev/react-turnstile@1.5.2` — when `VITE_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY` is empty, the field skips the widget and immediately fires `onToken('dev-token-no-site-key')` so dev/jsdom works without the real script (the Worker's `verifyTurnstile` bypasses on the same condition — symmetric). Submit stays `disabled` while `!turnstileToken || submitting`. CRITICAL gotcha: `authClient.signUp.email`'s TS type is strict (InferSignUpEmailCtx in `better-auth/dist/client/path-to-object.d.mts`) — extra fields like `turnstileToken` won't typecheck on the main arg; pass them via `fetchOptions: { body: { turnstileToken } }` instead. The proxy merges `fetchOptions.body` into the POST body before sending, so the before-hook on the Worker still sees `ctx.body.turnstileToken`. Success → `navigate('/check-email', { replace: true })`. Errors mapped pt-BR by `translateSignUpError`: `USER_ALREADY_EXISTS|USER_ALREADY_EXISTS_USE_ANOTHER_EMAIL`, `PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT`, `TURNSTILE_INVALID`, 429, else `error.message`. New `/check-email` route (`check-email-page.tsx`) under `<AuthLayout/>` with a 'reenviar' form calling `authClient.sendVerificationEmail({email, callbackURL: '/login'})`. Tests at `register-page.test.tsx` (7 cases) mock `@/lib/auth-client` and `@/features/auth/components/turnstile-field` to keep jsdom deterministic — no real Turnstile script load, no real fetch. Browser verification was NOT performed in this sandbox (no MCP browser tool wired in this iteration); manual smoke needed.

userStories.title: Engine — replayPayments (estado atual a partir de pagamentos reais)
userStories.description: Como desenvolvedor, preciso de uma função pura que dado (scenario + lista de pagamentos) retorne o estado atual e o cronograma restante.
acceptanceCriteria: Criar `src/core/finance/replay-payments.ts` exportando `replayPayments(scenario: FinancingScenario, payments: Payment[]): CurrentState`

Tipo `CurrentState`: { currentBalance: Decimal, remainingMonths: number, paidInterest: Decimal, paidPrincipal: Decimal, monthsAhead: number (parcelas adiantadas), nextScheduledPayment: Decimal, remainingSchedule: PrepaymentScheduleRow[], baselineSchedule: ScheduleRow[] (sem nenhum extra para comparação) }

Algoritmo: itera mês a mês ordenado por referenceMonth, calcula parcela base do mês, aplica pagamento. Se amount > parcela base: o excedente é amortização extra com a strategy registrada na linha. Se amount < parcela base: registra como pagamento parcial (juros incidem sobre saldo no próximo mês — comportamento simplificado: tratar como atraso adicionando juros sobre o saldo remanescente)
Lida com meses sem pagamento (saldo apenas acumula juros do mês — configurável; default = sim)
Sem mutação: retorna nova schedule e estado, não modifica inputs
Tudo em Decimal.js

Testes vitest com ≥ 12 cenários: (1) só parcelas exatas (sem extra), (2) amortização extra prazo, (3) amortização extra parcela, (4) sequência mista, (5) sem pagamentos retorna estado inicial, (6) todos pagamentos = liquida saldo, (7) pagamento maior que saldo final ajusta (sem saldo negativo), (8) pagamento parcial vira atraso, (9) mês sem pagamento, (10) snapshot estável (mesmo input → mesma saída), (11) baselineSchedule não muda com pagamentos, (12) economia em juros = sum(baseline.interest) - sum(actual.interest)

Após build: `bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply calculadora-financeira-db --remote` (com `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` e `CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID` em env)
Em seguida: `bunx wrangler deploy`
Concurrency group: `production-deploy` com `cancel-in-progress: false`
Documentar no `docs/deploy.md` os secrets necessários no GitHub: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN (escopo: Workers Scripts:Edit, D1:Edit, Account Settings:Read), CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
Job summary mostrando URL deploy (calculadorafinanceira.app) e SHA do commit
Workflow falha visível em caso de erro de migration ou deploy

userStories.title: Health endpoint com versão + docs de deploy/DNS
userStories.description: Como operador, quero observability básica via /api/health com SHA do commit e documentação completa de deploy/DNS.
acceptanceCriteria: Editar `src/server/index.ts` para que `GET /api/health` retorne `{ ok: true, version: __COMMIT_SHA__, environment: env.ENVIRONMENT ?? 'production' }`
Configurar `vite.config.ts` (define: { __COMMIT_SHA__: JSON.stringify(process.env.GITHUB_SHA ?? 'dev') })`

Criar `docs/deploy.md` com seções: (1) Setup inicial (criar D1, configurar wrangler.jsonc, secrets), (2) Apontar DNS no Cloudflare para `calculadorafinanceira.app`, (3) Configurar Resend (verificação de domínio + CNAMEs DKIM/SPF), (4) Configurar Turnstile (site key + secret), (5) Variáveis de ambiente, (6) Comandos para deploy manual, (7) Como tirar backup do D1: `bunx wrangler d1 export calculadora-financeira-db --remote --output=backup-YYYY-MM-DD.sql`
Adicionar `observability = { enabled = true }` ao `wrangler.jsonc` (logs no dashboard)
Smoke test pós-deploy documentado: `curl https://calculadorafinanceira.app/api/health` deve retornar `{ ok: true, version: <sha> }`
Atualizar `.env.example` se algum env var estiver faltando
